description:
Intent i019 (net-epidx, snapshot s05) complete. Three credible variants of the seed's missing-endpoint-count-validation mechanism found in USB networking drivers, all with literal source evidence:

1. s05:drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c:3581-3594 (high confidence): lan78xx_probe takes fixed indexes (intf->cur_altsetting)->endpoint + 0/1/2 (quote: 'dev->ep_intr = (intf->cur_altsetting)->endpoint + 2;') with no bNumEndpoints >= 3 check anywhere in the file's probe path (the only bNumEndpoints use is the type-scan loop at 2769 in lan78xx_get_endpoints, whose results are overwritten by these fixed-index assignments). ep_intr->desc.bEndpointAddress and .bInterval (3588-3591) program dev->pipe_intr and the interrupt URB period, and usb_maxpacket(..., dev->pipe_intr, 0) at 3593 sizes the kmalloc'd interrupt buffer — triggered by device plug-in; config.c:494-498 leaves the array NULL when num_ep==0, so this is a NULL-deref/OOB read past the descriptor array, same class as the seed.

2. s05:drivers/net/usb/r8152.c:1355 (high confidence): alloc_all_mem takes 'struct usb_host_endpoint *ep_intr = alt->endpoint + 2;' (alt = intf->cur_altsetting) and reads ep_intr->desc.bInterval at 1430 for tp->intr_interval used by the interrupt URB (usb_fill_int_urb at 1431, submitted in rtl8152_open at 3280); zero bNumEndpoints occurrences in the entire r8152.c file — no endpoint-count validation on any path from probe (4307) through open.

3. s05:drivers/net/usb/qmi_wwan.c:302-309 (high confidence in the invariant, impact caveat): qmi_wwan_register_subdriver takes &info->control->cur_altsetting->endpoint[0] whenever a CDC Union descriptor yields info->control != info->data, with no bNumEndpoints check on the control altsetting; &dev->status->desc is fed to usb_cdc_wdm_register (315) as the WDM interrupt descriptor. Noted honestly: the pure zero-endpoint case degrades to a caught NULL via the !dev->status test, so residual impact is the unvalidated non-interrupt descriptor feed to wdm_create; cdc_ether.c:293 shows the correct 'bNumEndpoints == 1' pattern that qmi_wwan lacks.

Evidence-backed negatives recorded: cdc-phonet.c:352 (validates both altsettings' bNumEndpoints 0/2 pattern before endpoint[0]/[1]), cdc_ether.c:293 (bNumEndpoints==1 + int-in + wMaxPacketSize validation), sierra_net.c:665 (rejects != 3), usbnet.c:112 usbnet_get_endpoints (shared bind for ~15+ NICs, type-scan loop), hso.c:3131-3164 (bounded scans + NULL checks), cdc_ncm.c:681, ipheth.c:503, and all drivers/net/wireless USB drivers (rtlwifi/usb.c:354, carl9170:1066, brcmfmac:1338, orinoco_usb:1605, p54usb:1018, at76c50x:2249, ath6kl, libertas, mwifiex, mt7601u, rt2x00, rtl8xxxu, rsi) use bNumEndpoints-bounded type scans; drivers/net/wwan does not exist in s05. Limitations: no compilation or dynamic reproducer (read-only snapshot); hardcoded-endpoint-address legacy drivers (kaweth/catc/pegasus/rtl8150/cx82310_eth/kalmia/gl620a) don't index the descriptor array and were excluded; ath10k/ath6kl HTC endpoint arrays are firmware-keyed internal structures, excluded; cdc_mbim/huawei_cdc_ncm runtime alt-switch paths belong to the if-alt-count branch. Artifact written to agent-state/findings/i019.json with snapshots_checked=["s05"], 3 findings, 16 candidates, execution_status=complete.
